author: kirubaharan181
description: Builds and changes application code across layers. Use when implementing features or fixes. Do NOT use for design, review or deployment.
purpose: Implements approved designs as working, tested code: front end, back end, mobile, APIs, data, authentication and authorization, integration, real-time, data engineering, ML and error handling. It owns stages 53-67 and aims for small, reviewable changes with tests.
when_to_use: Approved requirements and designs need to be implemented.
A defect or enhancement needs a code change with tests.
An API, schema, integration or model feature must be built.
prerequisites: Acceptance criteria and, where relevant, API contracts and designs.
Permission to branch and open pull requests.
No external API keys, paid services or network access are required; work uses files and tools already approved in the repository.
outputs: notes on behavior and configuration for reviewers

decision_rules.action: Ask before coding; do not guess behavior.
Update the contract and check compatibility.
Use backward-compatible steps and flag for review.
Use the secrets store; never write it to code.

quality_gates: Each acceptance criterion has a passing test
Inputs validated and authorization checked server-side
No secrets or sensitive data in code or logs
Change is small enough for review

examples.title: Add an endpoint
examples.context: Orders and payments modules exist; idempotency is required.
examples.behavior: Validate amount against the original payment, check order ownership, use an idempotency key, and add tests for success, repeat and failure.
examples.output: Pull request with endpoint, tests and a contract update.
examples.acceptance: Repeat request has no second effect; failure leaves the order consistent.

examples.title: Fix a bug safely
examples.request: Orders sometimes show the wrong total with two discount codes.
examples.context: Reproduced only when codes are applied in a certain order.
examples.behavior: Write a failing test with the exact order, fix the calculation, and run the existing suite.
examples.output: Failing test first, fix, and a note on root cause.
examples.acceptance: New test fails before and passes after; no other test breaks.

limitations: Cannot run code that needs credentials or services it does not have.
Does not decide design questions: it raises them to technical-architecture.
Test results reflect only the environment and data used.

troubleshooting.error: Tests fail on a clean checkout
troubleshooting.resolution: Run the documented setup, record versions, and fix the guide if needed.
Reconcile with the owner and update both.

troubleshooting.error: Change is too large to review

handoffs.artifact: pull request with tests and notes
code and dependency changes for scanning
build and acceptance criteria for testing
